quality_run_policy.technical_retry_result_policy: Record the first successful technical retry latency and retry count; if the retry fails, preserve the original frozen failure class. MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID is never retried.

system_a.threshold_source: gliner2 2.0.0 ExtractorRuntime.extract_entities default; the production call omits the argument and therefore uses exactly 0.5
system_a.inference_concurrency: serialized by one asyncio.Lock per model instance

labels.birth_expression: Word or phrase explicitly expressing a human birth, such as nasceu or nasci
labels.marriage_expression: Word or phrase explicitly expressing that a marriage occurred, such as casei, se casou, or casaram
labels.death_expression: Word or phrase explicitly expressing a human death, such as morreu, faleceu, or óbito
labels.stillbirth_expression: Word or phrase explicitly expressing a stillbirth or stillborn child
labels.person: Named person or explicit human participant or subject mention, including kinship mentions
labels.date: Explicit date, month, year, or temporal expression

system_a.temporal_normalization: Only an isolated four-digit year from 0001 through 9999 is normalized to its inclusive UTC year interval.

system_b.score_threshold: NONE; use model argmax/BIO output as returned by the frozen Transformers pipeline
system_b.subword_handling: Transformers 5.8.0 aggregation_strategy=simple over the fast tokenizer's offset mapping.
system_b.character_spans: Use pipeline start/end offsets unchanged and require text[start:end] to be nonempty; no fuzzy alignment.
system_b.duplicate_handling: Within a label, retain only the highest-score item for an exact duplicate start/end pair; ties retain first pipeline order.
system_b.overlap_handling: Retain non-identical overlapping spans; the frozen exact/relaxed metric performs deterministic one-to-one scoring.
system_b.dummy_tokenizer_validation: PASS: 'Ana nasceu em 2019.' produced exact offsets Ana=0:3 and 2019=14:18. No model weights or held-out text were used.

system_c.model_format: Hugging Face safetensors checkpoint at the frozen revision
system_c.input_serialization: Replace {{NARRATIVE}} once in the frozen prompt, place the complete result as one text item in one user message, then call the frozen revision's processor.apply_chat_template with add_generation_prompt=true and tokenize=true.
system_c.model_native_context: Not used as an experimental degree of freedom; execution is capped at 4096 input tokens.
system_c.output_extraction: Decode generated tokens only with skip_special_tokens=true; trim surrounding whitespace; parse the complete remainder as one JSON document.
system_c.access_precondition: The gated model revision must be available in the external Hugging Face cache before the authorized run; credentials are never recorded in protocol artifacts.
